The function should utilize regex matching to determine if the input string conforms to the specified pattern.
Repair Directions:
1. Use a regex pattern matcher to check if the input string matches the pattern "[A-Z][a-z]*".
2. Replace the equality check with a regex match operation.
3. Ensure the function reads the input correctly and applies the regex pattern to determine the output.
